pro_course_detail.title: General English (covering all 4 skills)
pro_course_detail.description:

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Have a job interview? Want to work abroad (or in Malta)? Not feeling confident at the workplace?

This course is aimed for intermediate to advanced students (B1-C2). We will work from the Cambridge Business English textbook, supplemented by original material tailored to your needs. Examples of topics covered:

👉 formal vs informal English
👉 how to write business emails
👉 Writing a CV, resume, or cover letter
👉 how to give presentations
👉 how to network
👉 finance and investment terminology

pro_course_detail.title: Maltese! --> Please book under the Maltese Language section of my profile :)
pro_course_detail.description:
* Note: Please book Maltese lessons under my Maltese language section - they are the same price. I keep this section here to make sure students realise I teach both languages :) *

Thank you very much for showing interest in Maltese! ❤️ Whilst Maltese is not a global language like English, it is the national language of Malta. If you are someone who wishes to relocate to Malta for the long-term, or who wishes to raise kids in Malta, learning Maltese is essential. In this class, I will introduce all the basics of Maltese, as well as recommend a beginner's Maltese book that we can work on together. If you have any further questions, do not hesitate to message me.

Grazzi ħafna għall-interess tiegħek fil-Malti! ❤️ Minkejja li l-Malti m'huwiex lingwa globali bħalma hu l-Ingliż, xorta waħda jibqa' l-lingwa nazzjonali ta' Malta. Jekk inti xi ħadd li tixtieq tgħix Malta fit-tul, jew li tixtieq trabbi t-tfal f'Malta, it-tagħlim tal-Malti huwa essenzjali. F'dan il-klassi, se nintroduċi affarijiet bażiċi dwar il-Malti, kif ukoll nintroduċi ktieb għall-prinċipjanti li nistgħu nużaw flimkien. Jekk għandek iktar mistoqsijiet, tistħix tibgħatli messaġġ.

pro_course_detail.title: Maltese SELF-STUDY Package
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you interested in learning Maltese at your own pace? This one-time self-study package provides all the materials you need to begin your journey towards fluency.  

📚 What’s Included?
✅ A single 60 minute live class with me
✅ Access to an *unlisted* YouTube series of lessons
✅ Step-by-step grammar book of A1 and A2 level
✅ Associated workbook of exercises, with answers
✅ Audio files featuring my own pronunciation guide for each text
✅ Chapter Revision worksheets, with answers
✅ Two short stories written in Maltese
✅ One week of unlimited messaging with me on any questions 
✅ Three essay corrections of ≤150 words each
✅ List of basic words Maltese to insert into your flashcard app
✅ A set of Maltese short conversation to pick up key phrases
✅ Recommended resources to continue your learning 

This package is ideal for independent learners who want a structured yet flexible approach to learning Maltese. Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to reinforce your foundation, this package will give you the tools you need to self-study this language notorious for having few materials on the internet. 

Material will be shared via online shareable links. Feel free to message me to inquire.

pro_course_detail.title: English Job Interview Preparation – One-Time Intensive Session
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have an important job interview coming up? This one-time, fully comprehensive session will equip you with all the tools and confidence you need to succeed.  

📝 What’s Included?
✅ 60-minute intensive session focused on your target job/industry
✅ Model answers for how to answer the most common interview questions
✅ Post-session feedback on your CV / résumé - I will correct it fully for you 
✅ Personalized and post-session feedback on your answers and speaking style
✅ Mock interview practice with realistic questions  

This session is ideal for professionals preparing for an English-language job interview, whether in-person or online. We will simulate a real interview, fine-tune your responses, and ensure you're fully prepared to impress your interviewer.

Be sure to drop me a message to clarify any details.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I am a very patient and calm person. I carry out my work diligently. I want to help my students overcome their language barrier and be able to fully experience the culture of a foreign country by learning its native language. Learning languages is the best way to live an extraordinary experience since communication is key. Learners can study vocabulary words very hard but somehow most people struggle to pronounce the words. I will make my best to make sure that my students are pronouncing the words correctly. Language exchange can be so fun even in a virtual classroom!
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons will be short and fun. Lessons will include general, daily conversational topics. If the person is a complete beginner, I will start by teaching syllables, verbs, tenses and vocabulary words. I will also take short and quick tests to examine the learner and see whether there has been any progress so far. I will carefully listen to what they have to say, note down their mistakes and then correct them at the end of each lesson. I like using notebooks and sometimes a whiteboard to explain so that the student does not get confused. I will also be using some resources such as books, storybooks, grammar, verb tenses books as well as dictionaries for references,and even blog articles!

teacher_info.intro:
I've been teaching languages for over 10 years with 6 years' experience in universities and 6 online. As a fellow language learner who is fascinated by how acquisition works, I know what works and what doesn't. We learn languages through stories and interactions that sustain our interest. In my classes, you do learn about the patterns of a language (the "grammar rules" colloquially) but this is not the focus of the classes.

You can expect:
❇️Original story-lessons
❇️Classes focused on listening & speaking about ideas, with occasional structured tasks to address difficulties that arise.
❇️To get better at using the language even though you aren't spending most of your time focused on rules.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
My goal is to get my students competent, comfortable and confident speaking the language, not just conjugating verbs by heart in isolation or performing controlled written exercises. When you work with me you will receive:
❇️An accurate assessment of your current level, strengths, difficulties.
❇️Appropriate challenge, genuine compliments, feedback about what you can do better and how.
❇️I write stories and create lessons from scratch for YOU with your interests, goals, and level of understanding in mind.
❇️You will be immersed in story-worlds and discuss characters, ideas, and themes as much as you please. The more you engage with the material, the more you will get out of the lessons.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
❇️ Material sent ahead of time: a recording, a PDF with the transcript of the story, vocabulary, and notes on grammar. 
❇️ Lesson focused on listening and speaking the target language: listen to the 2nd part of the story, discuss the characters and ideas presented. 
❇️ The focus is not on grammar, words in isolation or mechanical drills. Occasionally, I will provide tasks to address persistent pronunciation and grammar difficulties. 
❇️ Informed by Dr. Stephen Krashen's Input Hypothesis & Blaine Ray's story-learning
*NEW STUDENTS: Either include a message when you book or have a filled-in profile stating your goals.
teacher_info.cancel_policy:
-I do not accept CANCELLATIONS, except for genuine emergencies.
-RESCHEDULING A LESSON: 36h+ notice is required. Any less will be declined, with payment still due.

-If you NO-SHOW (no sign of life after 15 min), the lesson will be cancelled but payment will be due.

-EXCEPTIONS: I am understanding of and make exceptions for real emergencies (wife ran away, tornado hit, you're in hospital).
Please respect the time and preparation I put into lessons, as I do yours.

course_info.trial_description: This is an opportunity to meet, discuss your language goals and for me to evaluate your current level. We'll dive right into storytelling so that you get an idea of what lessons are like.

pro_course_detail.title: French through Storytelling (click for description)
pro_course_detail.description:
We learn languages through stories. When you book these lessons, I will send you a story that I write myself (transcript + recording). During the session we discuss your thoughts on the story, then practice further listening and commentary. The listening portion and questions are created carefully to enrich your vocabulary, improve your comprehension, and elicit the use of new grammatical structures. If your goals include understanding natural spoken French, speaking fluently, making the interaction a pleasure for all involved, and having meaningful conversations, these lessons are for you. The students who have enjoyed and gotten the most value from these lessons typically book a package: the better I know you as a student, the more tailored the stories are to your current level, interests and language goals. I've written travel stories, twists on Greek mythology, mysteries and fantastical tales, it all depends on what captures your interest.

This course includes:
-a story with a transcript, recording, discussion questions, vocabulary & notes on grammar sent before the lesson (the "exposure" to the language)
-a session that includes a listening activity (the 2nd part of the story) and focused questions intended to elicit rapid, accurate responses using the new words and structures presented.
-occasional assessment of current areas of weakness + mini tasks/exercises to address these

CANCELLATIONS/RESCHEDULING/LATE ARRIVALS/NO-SHOWS
Cancelling and rescheduling require at least 24h notice, preferably more because I typically have materials ready 2 days before. I will be there during the scheduled session. I don't reschedule for no shows or stay longer than scheduled if you are late.

PACKAGE DURATION
Must be used within six months of purchase. If you can't commit to 2-3 lessons per month, it's best to purchase individual lessons as needed.

pro_course_detail.title: 1-time coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you like being in control of your own language acquisition plan? Don't want to follow a teacher's book or preferred method? Unsure how to use all the resources at your disposal? Have questions about the "best" way to learn? I can help.

Whether you want to improve your listening comprehension, speak more fluently and clearly in sepcific situations (travel, interviews, casual and formal settings), read more easily or write better, I can help you build your study plan.

Includes:
1 detailed break-down of my own approach to languages (not just generic tips such as "listen to music in the target language" or "watch movies")
2 resource recommendations specific to your target language and interests (the more you tell me about yourself and why you are learning this language, the better the recommendations)
3 my evaluation of apps/methods/books you are considering

Book at least a week before to give me time to prepare, especially if you want me to evaluate other resources.

If the lesson needs to be scheduled, it should be done at least 24 hours ahead of time. I will be present during the schedule lesson and will not reschedule if you no-show. If you arrive late, the lesson will stil end at the official end time.

pro_course_detail.title: Better Spanish: Intentional Practice + Corrections + Recommendations (see description)
pro_course_detail.description:
To get better at a language, we not only have to spend a lot of time observing native speakers using it, listening to and reading content in the language, but also engage in mindful practice and honest, direct feedback from a teacher. If your goals include speaking well, going beyond the most basic communication, making the interaction a pleasure for all involved, and having meaningful conversations, you need focused, intentional practice in the areas that are the most difficult and uncomfortable for you right now. Repeatedly having the same conversations about familiar topics and making the same mistakes without trying to pause, reflect, and  correct yourself will not lead to any measurable progress even if you have invested hours and money into the project of foreign language learning. If you want to improve and use your time and money wisely, book this course.

During these lessons, I will:
-assess your areas of weakness, the ones most in need of attention.
-provide you with exercises/tasks that isolate this area (listening comprehension, pronunciation, a particular aspect of the grammar) so that you get focused practice.
-give you immediate feedback on whether you have understood the concept and whether you are improving.
-explain to you how to correct an error / help you improve your pronunciation or listening on the spot.
-provide recommendations for listening and reading in the form of podcasts, videos, songs, articles and other material to supplement lessons.

CANCELLATIONS/RESCHEDULING/LATE ARRIVALS/NO SHOWS
Cancelling and rescheduling require at least 24h notice, preferably more because I typically have materials ready 2 days before. I will be there during the scheduled session. I don't reschedule for no shows or stay longer than scheduled if you are late.

PACKAGE DURATION
Must be used within six months of purchase. If you can't commit to 2-3 lessons per month, it's best to purchase individual lessons as needed.

➡ Understanding and responding to rapid, casual French speech

✅ Personalized Approach:
As a native French speaker who has mastered English, I can precisely identify how your native language influences your French pronunciation and provide targeted techniques to overcome these specific patterns.

🔹 Lasting Results:
By the end of our session, you'll have:
✔ Practical techniques to continue improving your pronunciation independently
✔ Increased confidence for real-world French conversations
✔ A better ear for authentic French speech patterns
✔ The ability to self-correct using the methods I'll teach you
